title: No backing not skid proof at all
text: No backing not skid proof at all. It's a nice pattern but has no backing at all its just like an out side rug no cushion at all for the money I wish I'd opened it up b4 time for return. Had past or would have returned it not worth the money nor is it skid proof I have had it slip out from under me and had nice bruise on side from falling cuz of no backing for it to stay in place even the dogs have hard time it slides every where not worth the money

product_metadata.title: Home Dynamix Tribeca Jayden Area Rug 39"x55", Abstract Brown
features: CONTEMPORARY DESIGN FOR EVERY ROOM: Featuring geometric prints and patterns, bold colors, neutral hues and bold design, the Home Dynamix Tribeca Jayden area rug is the perfect addition to any modern style room.
ENDLESS DÉCOR OPPORTUNITIES: Enhance your bedroom, living room, dining room, den or entryway with this breathtaking décor must-have. It’s picture-perfect in every indoor space!
LOW MAINTENANCE: Your polypropylene area rug is so easy to clean and care for! All you have to do is vacuum regularly. Minimal effort, maximum beauty! Use non-skid padding underneath.
HIGH QUALITY AND DURABILITY: A unique blend of fashion, function and design. Design that exceeds expectations with a high-quality construction for long lasting beauty. Stain, fade and fray resistant.
SIZES FOR EVER SPACE: Our collection includes a variety of sizes to ensure you choose the size that fits your needs in area rugs, accent rugs, runners and rounds.
description: Indulge in your love for all things modern by adding a chic, contemporary design from the Tribeca rug collection by Home Dynamix into your home. With a stylish variety of geometric prints, striking colors, abstract swirl patterns and luxe textures, these area rugs are ideal for anyone updating a modern space. With mid-century modern and contemporary design influences, these rugs all feature an eye-catching design that’s sure to wow your guests! With a beautiful blend of fashion and function, these area rugs will elevate your home’s décor while bringing a warm and welcoming feel to every room with their soft texture. Unique abstract elements in each rug will complement your existing modern furniture and contemporary pieces of art for a cohesive design you will adore. Made of soft polypropylene, these all-over print area rugs will be a fashionable and long-lasting addition to your home with their effortless durability and style. These gorgeous area rugs are ideal for your bedroom, living room, dining room or den. Easily maintain your room’s ambiance as preservation of these rugs is hassle free. Stain and fade resistant, this area rug will continue to protect your floors and provide long lasting beauty for many years to come. The Tribeca area rug is perfect for indoor, high traffic areas with their naturally stain and fade resistant qualities. If needed, simply clean with vacuum or spot clean. Recommended use with non-skid padding is recommended (sold separately). Made in Turkey. Tribeca Rug 18.9"x31.5" F28-844
